title: 5GS update type
text: This IE shall be included when the UE is performing the registration procedure to indicate any of the following
a) the UE requests the use of SMS over NAS or there is a change in the UE's requirements to use SMS over NAS
b) a change in the UE's radio capability for NG-RAN; or
c) the UE requests CIoT 5GS optimizations
